_comment: Every creature's and boss's attacks (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.13, cooks/combat.md 2.17-2.18, cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.15-2.16). Read by FWRAttackRows (WRAttackRows.h); creatures fight by their rows (AWRCreatureAI::TickRowFight), bosses build theirs from them (AWRBoss::BuildAttacks). Fields: motion (bite, claw, sweep, kick, buffet, lunge, pounce, charge, roll, slam, spit, stomp, burst, howl, dust, withdraw), range [min, max] cm (the gap to the body; distance for spit / burst / howl), windup s (first tell frame to first active frame), track (share of the wind-up spent turning at 180 deg/s, then it commits), hold s (held at the top: a final glint + sting 0.2 s before contact), active s (only while the jaw / claw / body really travels), punish s (recovery: open), dmg (creatures: x their bite; bosses: flat), poise, impact 1-5, buildup {status: amount}, type slash / strike / pierce, flags (parryable, low, unblockable, grab, ignoreHyperarmor, behindOnly, readsAction, tamePunish, transition, thrown, ranged), projectileSpeed (never over creatureAI.maxProjectileSpeed, never homes), knockback, reach / arc (bite, claw, sweep), radius (stomp ring, burst, dust), speed (charge cm/s), wallStun s, next {id, chance} (combos, at most 4), cooldown s, weights {close, mid, far} (bands < 400, < 1200, beyond), tell {bone, glint white / crimson / none}. Bosses add shape (cone / line / self / target), range, size, repeats, gap, phase, maxPhase, height (0 ground, 1 air, 2 either), damageTaken (while it plays), holdOn (the repeat the hold applies to). All first drafts.

duckweed_burst._note: Only from water (WRSwampCreatures): the duckweed parts in a line toward you, bubbles, red eyeshine. Hit -> death roll 40% (swampCreatures.murkjaw.rollAfterBurst).

death_roll._note: Catch (WRSwampCreatures): held 2 s at 18/s (+2 s dragged under within 3 m of the water's edge); an ally's 120 on its head frees you; each mash press -0.15 s.

land_lunge_read._note: The land lunge with no hold, only as a read (a drink or a charged heavy within 8 m: WRSwampCreatures RowAllowed).

duckweed_burst._note: The grown Murkjaw's rows (cook 2.12.2) scaled to the young (cook 2.12.3: midland, 120 HP, ~4 m): the tier hit and stance are midland's (20 / 35), poise x0.65, impact -1, reaches x0.62, bleed x0.67; timings kept so its tells read the same. Only from water; hit -> death roll 40%.

death_roll._note: The same catch as the grown one (swampCreatures.murkjaw: held 2 s, +2 s dragged under by the water; an ally's 120 on its head frees you; mash -0.15 s a press).

land_lunge_read._note: The land lunge with no hold, only as a read (a drink or a charged heavy close by: WRSwampCreatures RowAllowed).

latch._note: Catch (WRSwampCreatures): blockable (a block knocks it off); on, it drains 6/s through ApplyHit with bleed 15/s and heals twice what it drains; off by a roll (60%), fire, a salt pouch, any ally's hit or its death. Max 3 on one survivor, one a limb.

spring_lunge._note: Flankers only (from the side, WRSwampCreatures RowAllowed).

swim_lunge._note: Only from water: a V-wake runs toward you.

latch._note: Vharra's brood (cook 2.14 Brood shed): Gorgeleech young shed from her sacs into the pool; they go for the furthest tame and latch on (WRSwampCreatures latch).
Swarm latch: drain 2/s, bleed 8/s while on (swampCreatures.latch_leech).

curse_cry._note: A cone 10 m x 40 deg from the beak (15 m in Miasma), line of sight, solid cover blocks it; curse 35 a crow, stacking. A hit on the crow in the wind-up cancels it.

dive_rake._note: After it, grounded 1.5 s (the bring-down window: each hit on it then keeps it down longer).

peck_flurry._note: Three pecks; on the ground only; the murder prefers latched, held or downed survivors.

call_murder._note: Calls every Hexcrow within 60 m; once per fight.

tongue_lash._note: The throat pumps twice, the pale tip shows. Sweeps along the tongue; a hit pulls you 600 cm (halved at full guard); a sideways roll clears it. Pulled within 2 m -> gulp.

gulp._note: Only after a tongue pull: inside the mouth 15/s for 2.5 s; an ally's 100 on its throat spits you out; mash -0.15 s a press; spat out knocked down.

belly_flop._note: Leaps to a point up to 800 cm off; the landing ring 350 cm is low (a jump clears it).

mud_spit._note: A ballistic glob at where you stood (900 cm/s, gravity, never homes, never inside 450 cm): slowed 3 s.

clatter._note: The bill-clatter the moment one is hit: the herd within 30 m turns on the attacker together (WRSwampCreatures).

gape_chomp._note: The hippo yawn: jaws open 150 deg, tusks bared, a low grunt. The same yawn is its warning before it turns on you.

wallow_surge._note: Only in water: it sinks, a bulge rises, and the body comes up under you (300 cm, not low: roll out).

flash_puff._note: The sac swells and brightens; a 3 m flash dims the view 1.5 s (Blind); then it hops away.

withdraw._note: Never attacks: any hit pulls it into the shell, damage x0.3 for 6 s (WRSwampCreatures).

lunge_read._note: The lunge with no hold, only as a read: a drink or a cast within 0.4 s (combat KEPT readsAction).

hamstring._note: From behind, at the legs: slowed x0.8 for 2 s (WRVoidCreatures Resolved).

blink._note: Movement: its body shudders and it draws one hard reversed breath (the tell), a lensing ripple shows at the destination 0.5 s before it arrives; 4-6 m to 90-150 deg off your facing. Its next attack still plays its full wind-up.

rift_burst._note: Opener, only out of a rift within 8 m (WRVoidCreatures RowAllowed): the rift's edge bulges, the tooth ring shows inside, a sucking gasp.

four_jaw_grab._note: The jaw-plates flare open, crimson on the tooth ring. Catch 1.4 s paired (WRVoidCreatures). Roll through it.

retreat._note: At 25% HP or after 3 attacks: 1.5 s back into its rift; it returns 6 s later through any rift within 30 m. More than 30 m from a rift it can't (forced only).

dive._note: Screech, wings fold. Grounded 1.5 s after it (the bring-down window).

trail_pass._note: It banks wide, its wing holes flare: a 30 m black ribbon laid across your route, 1-4 m up, never inside 3 m of you. Touch: 8 a tick (0.5 s), curse 30/s. A placed hazard, not a projectile.

void_spit._note: Never homes; at 5 m and 1,000 cm/s the wind-up and flight are 1.25 s.

latch._note: It crouches and chitters, then latches: 3 a second and 3 max HP a second into MaxHealthLost. A roll or any hit on you shakes every latched Gnawer off.

listening_rise._note: A pose, not an attack: it rises to full height, its ear fans unfold with a leathery snap, two taps of the long finger. Hears x2 while risen.

lift._note: Both arms open wide, crimson on the long finger. Catch 1.6 s: lifted to its face, the ears fold over you, it screams (+ stagger, 40 stamina).

scream._note: Ear fans flare, chest heaves: drains 50 stamina and cancels a drink or cast under way; guarding halves it.

blink_kick._note: Tell 0.5 s: a lensing ripple behind you; it blinks there, then the rear kick (0.4 s of its own wind-up after the blink: 0.9 s in all).

withdraw._note: 25% of its stance inside 2 s: it folds into its shell for 3 s, damage x0.2 (the Basaltback's rule).

pulse._note: When hit: a 1.5 s dimming pulse, then it rises 10 m and drifts off.

headbutt._note: Cornered or hit; then it flees.

hook_swipe._note: The arm rises, the claws uncurl and spread.

hammer_down._note: Reared on its hind legs, both arms high, claws hooked (the belly open x1.3, WRForestCreatures); blockable, not parryable; the impact ring 300 cm is low (a jump clears it). The claws sink in: 1.2 s punish with the chest open.

maul_hug._note: Stands tall, arms wide, a deep huff. Catch (WRForestCreatures): 18/s for 2.5 s then thrown 5 m; an ally's 120 on its head frees you; each mash press -0.15 s. Dodge only.

bull_rush._note: Head drops, a ground scrape with both claws. Into a trunk: stunned 2.5 s.

roar._note: Once a fight, its opening (WRForestCreatures): survivors within 12 m stagger 0.6 s unless guarding; widowmakers within 6 m of it drop (WRForest::DropWidowmakers).

hook_swipe_read._note: The hook swipe with no hold, only as a read (a drink or a charged heavy in reach).

canopy_drop._note: Only from a perch 6-12 m up a trunk (WRForestCreatures): a shadow grows on the ground, bark and leaves rain down, a rustle overhead; then it drops. Blockable. If it hits: the fang bite 50% (thornlynx.biteAfterDrop).

paw_swipe2._note: The second swipe 0.15 s after the first.

fang_bite._note: The jaw gapes to 90 degrees, the sabre canines show.

tree_escape._note: Below 40% health, a trunk within 15 m (WRForestCreatures): it climbs and waits 4-8 s to drop again. An arrow, a thrown stone or Vine lash brings it down (falls, 1.5 s grounded).

log_strike._note: Only from its log rest (WRForestCreatures): the log breathes, a hiss, the head lifts from the root tangle. If it hits: the constrict 50% (rootcoil.constrictAfterStrike).

constrict._note: Coils slide out on both sides of you in a ring. Catch (WRForestCreatures): 20/s for 3 s, stamina -30; an ally's 120 on its head frees you (strike x1.5), fire on it frees you at once; mash -0.15 s. Dodge out of the ring or jump.

body_slam._note: Rears 3 m high, the neck flares; comes down r 250 cm where you stood (blockable). The head lock point is open 1.2 s after.

sting_dive._note: Hovers, the abdomen curls forward, the wing pitch rises. Blockable. Eight wasps sting about 4 times a second in all.

scout_mark._note: A scout hovers at your head and fans its abdomen; a pale dust puff (WRForestCreatures): marked 30 s, every Bramblewasp within 40 m and every nest within 40 m comes for you. Water (wading or swimming) or smoke washes it off. No death burst (real hornets don't burst).

antler_charge._note: Head low, two hoof scrapes. A trunk hit stuns it 2.5 s.

bugle._note: Plays the moment one is hit (WRForestCreatures): the herd within 40 m turns on the attacker.

crash._note: Head down, a bellow, a short run-up. Hyperarmor.

sting._note: The abdomen curls, the buzz drops in pitch. Only near its hive or when hit (WRForestCreatures).

heat_ball._note: Several bees converge on one target, the hum rises (WRForestCreatures): it clings 3 s, 6/s per clinging bee (at most 4), each -10% move; a roll knocks one off (40%), fire on you knocks all off. On a Bramblewasp: x3 and it grabs and kills it in 3 s. On wasps, and on survivors at its hive.

rising._note: From buried (WRGraveCreatures): the soil heaves in a 1 m ring, two soul-green eyes open in the dirt, a dry rattle of breath. Night or a den; in Corpse fog it rises from any mist within 40 m.

hamstring._note: Circles to your flank, head low, the growl dropping; only from behind or the side: stamina -15 and your sprint broken 1.5 s. Flankers use it while a packmate faces you.

pounce._note: Crouch, the spine ridge flexing up like hackles. Knocks down.

grim_howl._note: Head back, the skull face to the sky: every buried hound within 40 m rises. Once a fight. A pack you hear howling is bigger than the one you see.

whip_sweep._note: The whips draw back and fan out: a touch is no harm, but you are found (a click-lock): its next attack has no delay hold. In the dark it attacks only what it touched or heard.

palp_snatch._note: Palps open wide, spines splay, a crimson glint on them: dodge it. Caught: pinned to the nearest wall 2 s at 15 a second; an ally's 150 damage on the palps frees you; mash to slip out sooner.

ceiling_drop._note: From a ceiling or a wall above, underground and in tombs only: chalk dust sifts over you, dry clicking above.

lateral_rush._note: Body flattens to the floor and it runs sideways through you; ends on a wall, out of reach 2 s.

light_dive._note: Wings fold, the thorax turns so the skull faces you, a rising squeak. The brightest light within 30 m first; a hit puts out a held torch; grounded 1.4 s after (the bring-down window).

scale_dust._note: Wings beat hard in place, pale dust lifting off them: a 6 m cone (not a projectile; cover blocks it): stamina -25 and chilled (stamina comes back at x0.6 for 6 s).

tear_drinker._note: Only on a knocked-down or staggered survivor: it lands and walks to you, wings half open, proboscis uncoiling; on your face 2.5 s (6 a second, stamina 8 a second, your view darkened to a sliver). Mash, any hit on it or fire takes it off.

rear_strike._note: Rears, forelegs high, a shrill scream.

charge._note: Stamps twice, head low. It never tires, so it charges again after 3 s; into a wall: stunned 2 s.

slab_slam._note: Rears on its back legs, the headstone tipping forward over you (its belly open x1.3 while it rears). Guard-breaking.

carrion_spray._note: The abdomen tips up with a wet click: a 5 m cone behind it (the real burying beetle's defensive secretion), not a projectile.

mob_dive._note: Caw, wings fold: the whole group dives in turn, only once one of them is hurt (the crow funeral's mob).

boxing_kick._note: Only when cornered; it flees zig-zag.

wax_squirt._note: Cornered: a squirt of hot wax (slowed x0.8 for 3 s), then it flees with its glow pulsing.

butt._note: Head lowers; the herd butts together.

grave_grasp._note: It kneels and plunges a hand into the ground: a bone hand rises under you and holds you 1 s. Jump it.

coffin_ram._note: They lower the coffin and lean in.

head_swing._note: The head cocks back and the plates rattle (readsAction: within 0.4 s of a drink or a charged heavy it comes with no hold).

glare._note: Plates tilt to the brightest light within 15 m (a held light, a lit crystal, a Lumenhorn) with a rising glassy whine and a lilac glint, and throw it into your eyes: the screen whites out to 40% for 1 s and your lock drops (not the Blind status). Only with such a light (WRCrystalCreatures).

leg_spear._note: The body above clouds pink-grey as blood floods back, a dry glassy tick as one leg lifts, and it stabs straight down (only once it has felt your steps within 8 m and you are under its span).

lift._note: Two forelegs part wide, crimson glints on the tips: lifts you 3 m to the mouth and bites twice (WRCrystalCreatures: 60 damage to it drops you).

dive_bite._note: A 0.5 s scream, the wings fold; grounded 1 s after.

shriek._note: Hangs back, mouth wide, ears forward, a rising whistle; the ripple travels 9 m/s (sound, not a projectile: it can't be reflected); staggers 0.4 s; wax earplugs take the stagger off.

latch._note: Rears, mandibles wide, and clamps on for 3 s: mark 10 a second (WRCrystalCreatures; at most 4 on you; a roll or a hit shakes one off).

bellow._note: Neck stretched, a rising roar: a 40 m noise (crystals flare, every Echobat that hears it comes).

roll_ram._note: Curls, plates grinding, and rolls; bounces off walls.

bite._note: The Crypt Mother's young (GY 2.13.2): 8-damage bites in a swarm.

stoop._note: Climbs, the double crest flares, a rising scream; the line locks at the fold and it comes down it at 36 m/s (never homing). Grounded 1.5 s after (the bring-down window). A gliding survivor first; the stoop closes a glider.

talon_rake._note: From a hover, feet thrown forward.

wing_buffet._note: Wings drawn back and clapped forward: push 5 m (near an edge it kills).

meat_theft._note: Only on a survivor with raw meat: the stoop takes a piece and it flies off 60 m with it (frigatebird).

undertow._note: Hovers off the lip, horn-lobes unroll, a rising whoosh, dust and grass pulled toward it: 500 cm/s toward its mouth in a 15 m, 40 degree cone for 1.5 s (off the lip = the fall). Brace x0.5, anchor boots none; a hit to its mouth with 30 stance or more cancels it. Never inside 4 m.

undertow_read._note: The Undertow within 0.4 s of a drink on an island lip.

wing_slap._note: The near wing rises high and falls: push 6 m.

barb_strike._note: Passes over you and the tail arcs down; the barb glints 0.2 s before.

belly_flop._note: Rises 15 m, its shadow grows on the ground, then down: an impact ring 6 m at 12 m/s (jump it).

antler_charge._note: Hoof scrape, head low; knockback 9 m. Into a wall or a tree it's stunned 2.5 s.

hind_wing_kick._note: The hind-wings snap open, talons out, at what stands behind it.

takeoff_gust._note: All four wings beat down: a ring of air 6 m pushes out 6 m; it's up 4 s, then comes back down with a charge.

fluke_slam._note: The fluke rises high behind it and slams: low, 4 m.

body_bump._note: A shove of the whole body: push 6 m.

spout._note: A whistle at the blowhole, then the spout: anyone on or over its back is thrown 6 m up.

hiss_peck._note: Cornered: a hiss, a peck, then it runs for the nearest edge and parachutes off.

hook_bite._note: The neck snakes back, the beak opens.

dagger_kick._note: A hop, one leg high: the 12 cm claw glints.

hop_pounce._note: Wings spread, a crouch, then the hop-glide down or across a gap (from 3 m above you or over open air).

impale._note: Dodge it. Seized and slammed onto the nearest thorn tree or stake within 6 m: bleed 60, pinned 1.5 s (mash: -0.15 s a press). No tree near: thrown 4 m.

rattle._note: The rattle: packmates within 50 m come, once a fight.

silent_swoop._note: The only sound: a rising churr; the facial disc flashes white 0.2 s before contact. It starts only on screen or within 8 m.

silent_swoop_read._note: Without the hold, inside 0.4 s of a drink or a raised torch.

gape_snap._note: On the ground after a swoop: the head splits open.

wing_smother._note: The wings mantle up and wide like a cloak: dodge. Wrapped up to 3 s, 8 a second (mash to free); allies break it with 60 stance.

lash._note: The bell contracts, the beads pulse brighter, a wet crackle: the curtain sweeps out 8 m below and round it; Slowed 3 s.

ceiling_drop._note: Opener, only from a ceiling or wall within 8 m above: grit trickles, a dry stalk-rattle overhead, the crest's cyan tips glint; it drops (its own weight) and lands in a 2.6 m ring, blockable (WRFungalCreatures).

gill_bite._note: The orange gill ruff flares open round the jaw (WRFungalCreatures). readsAction: within 0.4 s of a drink or a charged heavy it comes with no hold.

stalk_volley._note: It arches its back, the crest's stalks swell and lock upright with a rising creak; five pellets lobbed on high arcs land in a 4 m spread round where you stood (900 cm/s, never homing), each a 2 m cloud for 4 s, poison 25 (WRFungalCreatures).

mound_burst._note: Opener from its mound: the caps shiver outward in a ring, spores puff from under the rim, then it bursts up: 360 degrees, 3.5 m, blockable (WRFungalCreatures).

lure_snap._note: Reach within 1.5 m of its lure (the lone "deepcap") and the lure jerks back into the mouth, the mound's caps shiver, a crimson glint on the beak: dodge only; held 1.5 s at 15 a second (WRFungalCreatures). Strike the lure from range and it comes out stunned 2 s.

rot_belch._note: The throat swells rust-coloured with a gurgle; a 6 m x 40 degree cone of rot gas, four ticks (rot 18 each), not a projectile. It rears: its belly shows (x1.3) (WRFungalCreatures).

shell_spin._note: It hunkers, the mound's caps clench, and it spins: 360 degrees, 3 m, not low (roll out). Tipped, its belly shows (x1.3).

latch._note: It rears, front legs spread, the barbed hypostome flicks out, and clamps on: a block flicks it off; on, it drains 2 a second and poisons 6 a second, x0.9 move speed per mite, at most four on one survivor (one per limb). A roll (half the time), fire on you, a hit on it or its death take it off (WRFungalCreatures).

ceiling_pounce._note: A single bright thread drops to the floor beside you, then its eyes catch the light above; it comes down the thread (blockable) (WRFungalCreatures).

web_shot._note: The abdomen tilts up and the spinnerets pulse; a net flies at 900 cm/s with a little drop, never homing: webbed 2 s (no moving or rolling; you can still swing; each button press frees you 0.15 s sooner) (WRFungalCreatures).

tongue_whip._note: The throat pumps and the cheeks bulge; the tongue whips out 4.5 m and pulls you 3 m in (WRFungalCreatures).

leap_slam._note: It crouches and its legs tremble, then leaps for a point up to 12 m off: the landing's ring (3.5 m) is low: jump it (WRFungalCreatures).

croak_blast._note: The throat sac swells to the size of its head, translucent: a 4 m ring of sound (knockback 4 m); Webspinner lines within 8 m snap; the colony's rally call (WRFungalCreatures).

club_tail._note: The tail lifts and swings back, its spikes rattling: a 140 degree arc behind and to the side, 4.5 m.

burrow_pop._note: The floor bulges and cracks in a line toward you; it comes up under you.

bite._note: Bursts on death: a 2 m spore puff, poison 15 (WRFungalCreatures).

kyrra._comment: Kyrra, the Tempest Harrier (SKY 2.10). dive = the Tempest stoop (the built dive: down out of the sky onto where you stood, grounded 1.6 s after; WRSkyBosses adds the 4 m landing ring). snatch carries you 20 m up over 3 s and drops you (allies free you with 120 stance on her body). Screech calls 2 Galeharriers within 200 m, once. Height 1 = in the air, 2 = either (she fights on foot with both wings broken).

bridge_sentinel._comment: The Bridge Sentinel (SKY 2.10). vane_slam on a weak deck section breaks it: he falls 35 m to Winch Isle (25% of his health, kneels 10 s). deck_throw pries a 2 m deck stone (a hole for 2 game hours) and lobs it at 12 m/s on a gravity arc (the shadow shows; never inside 4 m). grab_hurl throws you 12 m sideways. vane_spin: the vanes whine up, 15 every 0.25 s for 1 s in 6 m, pushing out 6 m/s (WRSkyBosses).

old_gulper._comment: Old Gulper (SKY 2.10). inhale pulls 500 cm/s in a 20 m cone for 2 s; reach the mouth and you're swallowed (4 s inside, 12 a second, spat 15 m any way). A fire hit or a lit pot in the mouth while it inhales: it chokes (10 s on the lagoon, mouth open, x1.5). barnacle_shed drops 5 barnacles, each shadow growing 0.9 s before (r 2 m). belch only after a swallow.

aeolith._comment: Aeolith, the Sky Serpent (SKY 2.11). Phase 1: tail_sweep, gale_gust (the gale breath: a 25 m, 35 degree cone of wind, push 15 m/s; wind-stones block it; after it the empty sac opens the chest x1.3 for 1.4 s), coil_1-3 (bite, bite, crush: the third unblockable), crosswind_dive (a straight line through the Ring's centre, 6 m wide, unblockable: the plume counter), feather_volley (12 quills at 14 m/s from 6 m, never homing; wind-stones block), snatch (tame-punish: the furthest tame first). The Unbinding at 50% (transition). Phase 2 adds updraft_inhale, downburst, spiral (dive, coil, tail), held_gale. Hidden phase 3 at 25% (artifacts): the Last Circle (WRSkyBosses). Numbers in tuning bosses.aeolith.

lyrathis._comment: Lyrathis, the Prism Sovereign (crystal 2.14.2; W/H/A/P from the cook). WRCrystalLyrathis runs the Prism beam (a guide thread from her brow gem to the prism nearest her, then three rays fanned 30 degrees out of its far face sweeping 40 over the active time, traced against the hall; the centre ray bends toward the furthest tame), the Shard rain (8 shards over 2 s round each survivor, each shadow growing 1 s before it lands), the grasp's hold, the Prism ward (forced at 85% and 65%: the dome), the Sundering Flare (the transition: line of sight to her heart; cover behind a prism, a pillar or the dais), the copies (phase 2: they repeat her moves 0.5 s later), the Glint lance (it stands in the floor 20 s as a prism) and phase 3's turning beam (all_prisms).

mirrored_twins._comment: The Mirrored Twins (crystal 2.13.1; W/H/A/P from the cook). WRCrystalBosses drives the double: it stands mirrored across the real knight's target and plays every move at the same instant from its own place (the lunge converging from the other side); its blows are never parryable. The swap (every bosses.mirrored_twins.swapEvery s, the lens flaring 1.0 s, the real one taking no damage) and the Ward guard's reflection are the machine's, not rows.

echo_warden._comment: The Echo Warden (crystal 2.13.2). WRCrystalBosses: it hears noises (the noise model's radii) within hearRange cm and goes to the loudest of the last hearSeconds; Fork slam lands on that point (the target circle there, not on you); a struck chime stone sends it to hammer it (chime_hammer, forced, its back to the room: stance x behindStance); Listening holds it still 2 s and any noise in it forces the Snap lunge at that noise; after any of its blows lands it rings the Resonance blast (a low ring you jump).

geode_tyrant._comment: The Geode Tyrant (crystal 2.13.3). WRCrystalBosses: its six plate rows throw back every spell and shot from their side while whole (strike cracks them: rowHealth, rowStance); the Plate charge runs its line at 1,300 cm/s up to 1.6 s and a selenite beam in its way shatters and stuns it beamStun s; the Glare needs a light within glareLight cm; the Shard shrug lobs shards into a ring, each landing spot glinting the whole flight.

hood_snap._note: Vharra, Queen of the Mire (cooks/biome-swamp.md 2.14; WRSwampVharra.cpp runs the moves that aren't plain cones). Phase 1 on her anchor: hood snap, three-jaw drain (grab), the tail lash x3, blood spray, clot spit, anchor heave, the Brood shed (tame-punish). The Sinking at 50%. Phase 2 swimming: ambush rise, drowning coil, snap snap drag, the held blood spray; keeps the hood snap, drain, clot spit and brood. Hidden phase 3: snap snap snap drag.

mother_maw._comment: Mother Maw (cook 2.13.1; W/H/A/P from the cook). Rearing on the planks (WRSwampBosses): snaps and the slam from water at a target on a deck make her rear (belly x1.3, +1.2 s punish). The burst and the roll only from open water at a target off the planks. The slam breaks the section it lands on. nest_roar is forced at 60% and 30% (weights 0).

hex_warden._comment: The Hex-Warden (cook 2.13.2). The bone totem adds curse 30 to the sickles while it stands (WRSwampBosses ModifyHit); crow_scatter needs the crow totem, mimic_call the voice totem and a tame in the fight; reform_strike only comes out of a scatter (weights 0); hex_bolt never inside 5 m, a 1,000 cm/s bolt that never homes.

bloat._comment: The Bloat (cook 2.13.3). The latch is blockable (knocked off) and holds 4 s: 10 a second, bleed 20 a second, a roll 60% off, no latch while it burns (WRSwampBosses). The spray needs a vein left. burst is forced at 100% gorge (weights 0): an 8 m ring, an 8 m bleedwater puddle for 20 s, then it is staggered 6 s.

unravelled._comment: The Unravelled (biome-void 2.13.1). reform_slam is forced by its reform (weights 0); choir_note's ring rides out at 900 cm/s (low: jump it).

mother_of_rifts._comment: Mother of Rifts (biome-void 2.13.2). open_rift opens a brood rift in a pen (WRVoidBosses); sink_burst and the grab are hers out of the lair rift.

starving_one._comment: The Starving One (biome-void 2.13.3). Each blow or grab that lands eats a buff and grows a stack (WRVoidBosses).

null_warden._comment: The Null Warden (biome-void 2.13.4). The third sweep is the best parry; bell_toll strips a buff and 30 stamina in 15 m (guarding halves it).

echo._comment: The Echo (biome-void 2.13.5). mimic casts its own version of the last path ability that hit it (WRVoidBosses): enemy rules, never homing, nothing inside 4 m, max 1,600 cm/s, x0.8.

vorhollow._comment: Vorhollow (biome-void 2.14). gnashing is the transition (crimson, the chains snap, the island splits); hollow is the shell (forced at 80/60/40%); P2 rows from phase 2. The Inhale's pull, the beam's sweep, the Rift dive's lensing ring and the pieces are WRVoidBosses.

old_gnarl._comment: Old Gnarl (cook 2.13.1; W/H/A/P from the cook). WRForestBosses runs the boulder (a stump and its root ball on a 1,400 cm/s gravity arc with its shadow, never inside 8 m, stopped by a stump in the way), the grasp's hold (15/s for 2.5 s then thrown 8 m; 100 from an ally on the arm frees you) and the regrow (forced when a stripped plate can regrow: 1.5 s, fire cancels it with a 2 s stagger).

bramblequeen._comment: The Bramblequeen (cook 2.13.2). She flies the hive's open middle (WRForestBosses keeps her inside it). The sting lance is her own 6 m lunge (in flight; a miss sticks the stinger 1.1 s); the pheromone mark marks everyone in its 6 m 60 deg cone 30 s; the swarm call (weights 0) is forced every 25 s while a comb lives: 6 Bramblewasps from that comb.

grey_matron._comment: The Grey Matron (cook 2.13.3). In her canopy (WRForestBosses: the walkway graph) she has only the canopy drop (her shadow grows where she lands) and the bridge leap (a swooping bound tree to tree that rakes whoever's under its line); on the ground (4 of 6 walkways down, or her oak has none) the bite and the paws, every paw combo +1.2 s punish. kit_scream is forced at 60% and 30% (weights 0).

hornwarden._comment: The Hornwarden (cook 2.13.4). The charge runs on his legs at 1,500 cm/s and a trunk or a standing stone stuns him 2.5 s; roots stop it. The antler toss (grab) throws you 10 m and is gone with an antler broken (1,200 each: tuning bosses.hornwarden.antlerPartHealth). The bellow sends his herd at you; enraged (his herd hurt) it comes every 12 s and his punish windows shrink x0.7.

sylvaroth._comment: Sylvaroth (cook 2.14). Phase 1 rooted: the sweep x3 combo, root eruption (a 25 m bulging line, not a projectile), seed bombs (six pods at where everyone stood, 1.2 s on a gravity arc, never inside 4 m), the root hand (a crimson-rimmed 3 m ring under you; its wrist 600 frees), the canopy shake (8 branches over 4 s, never within 8 m of a heart-tree), the thorn whip (the furthest tame, else a plant summon). The Uprooting at 50% (unblockable 20 m ring, lines dark 10 s). Phase 2 walks: knuckle charge (stops 6 m short of a heart-tree), hammer fists (a low ring after), thrash x4, re-root (6 s of healing), the vine sectors (tuning, every 30 s); phase 1's moves x0.9 time, x1.1 damage. Hidden phase 3: the heart-trees wake (tuning p3*).

bell_ringer._comment: The Bell-Ringer (GY 2.13.1; W/H/A/P from the cook). WRGraveBosses forces the Toll every tollEvery s while the rope holds (raising 3 Risen mourners from the yard mounds within 15 m, max 9) and runs the headstone (a 1,500 cm/s stone on a gravity arc, left standing as cover where it lands) and the Knell's hold (he rings the hand-bell against your head three times). Cut the rope: no Toll, no rope lash, stance 60, and Hand-bell ring.

crypt_mother._comment: The Crypt Mother (GY 2.13.2). WRGraveBosses runs the whip sweep's find (her next move has no delay hold), the palp snatch's pin (18/s for 2 s; 200 from allies on a palp frees you), the ceiling drop (she climbs into the dark over one player and drops), the Brood shed (6 young at the player furthest from her; once per 25 s while she carries young) and the sacs' hatching.

ossuary_lord._comment: The Ossuary Lord (GY 2.13.3). WRGraveBosses runs the ribcage's hold (12/s for 3 s; allies breaking its ribs (180) open it), the bone spray (5 shards, a 30 deg fan, 1,500 cm/s, never home), the collapse and surge (a 10 m wave of bone, low, and it stands up behind you), the pile (re-forms in 8 s at 50% unless a Nature root lands on it, 2 lime pots break on it, or its 3 keystones are smashed) and the chandelier (its chain cut over him: 400 and a 4 s stance break, once).

gravedigger._comment: The Gravedigger (GY 2.13.4). WRGraveBosses runs Bury (a 3 m circle: buried up to 5 s, 10/s, stamina regen 0; mash -0.2 s a press, an ally holding E digs you out in 1 s), the Mortsafe (shoved into the cage on his back, 8/s for 6 s; the door 300 HP or 200 on his back from allies frees you; from inside you hit the door at x0.5) and his lantern (150 HP: smashed, he swings at where he last saw you for 10 s, then lights a spare once).

nhal._comment: Nhal, the Last Mourner (GY 2.14). Phase 1: Reaping arc, the Three-cut lament, Grave hands (a 2.5 m circle under every player within 20 m), the Keen (25 m x 70 deg, line of sight: pillars and tombs block it), the Shroud (grab), Lantern cast (a grave-fire pool 4 m for 6 s); Lay to rest on the furthest tame. The Opening at 50% (a 14 m ring, every tomb opens, the veil lifts, the chapel goes dark). Phase 2: a Risen every 25 s from each open tomb (max 8), Widow's lunge, the Unhinged keen, Requiem. Hidden phase 3 at 25% (artifacts): the Procession.
